newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 12, 6-mo T-bill yields up, 3-mo unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 12, 6-mo T-bill yields up, 3-mo unchanged.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills stood at 57.25 percent, the same as at the last sale on September 19, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Wednesday.
Results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 66.793 million UAH 15.701 million UAH
Actual amount raised 58.451 million UAH 13.740 million UAH
Ukraine's central bank sold 667,934 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 536,067 were competitive and 131,867 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of discount three-month T-bills is scheduled for Wednesday, September 25.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills rose to 59.87 percent against 59.50 percent at the last sale on September 19, a central bank statement said.
Results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 9.354 million UAH 1.016 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.203 million UAH 784,000 UAH
The central bank sold 93,536 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 88,078 were competitive and 5,458 were non-competitive bids.
The next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for Wednesday, September 25.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills rose sharply to 61.96 percent from 31.67 percent at the last sale on August 17, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 2,627 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
